increment_paragraph: **SETTLED-LEAK-MARK-LEAFLESS** (gateway rule 84 amended in place, with amendment lines in rules 74c and 6; new `QCore.SettledLeakLeafless`; user decision of 2026-11-28, option (b); [report](../../reports/settled-leak-mark-leafless/README.md)). Beside no `Unknown` or `Pending` leaf at the settle point a mark is no refusal's (rule 43's `ElementsReleased` withdraws every object the caller published), and rule 74c's held report still decided the identity by schedule: the probe at `287dce8ed` pinned three caller shapes over an imported `drain`, each `Unsafe` with one leak when the arm leaving `x` open reached the exit first and `Unknown` when the drained arm did. `legacy_mark_leafless.rs` takes as candidates the marked current-generation identities the settled exit would claim but for the mark (live, not exempt, no reference family): each is published on rule 84's witness, and otherwise withdrawn with the new `Unknown` reason `mark-without-refusal` at the exit; never `Safe`, the reason never `Unsafe`, schedule-independent (Lean `outcome_is_order_independent`, `a_leafless_decision_is_never_safe`, `agrees_with_rule_84_beside_a_blocking_leaf`). Pins: the open refusal-free arm `Unsafe` in both orders; the open arm through a retained loop exit `Unknown` with the reason in both orders; the published-then-drained body `Safe` with no reason. Suite census: 174 marked exit lines at base and tip; beside no leaf, 9 non-claimable (a published, `ESCAPED` object in `cross_unit_elements_released`, not an entry-custody site as earlier recorded) plus the new fixtures'; no other claimable leafless mark. Opt-in `current --monkey-linked` over Fluent Bit 046accf6, base `287dce8ed` and tip `2e949e11a` each on its own tree and binary: both 1,209/2/3,586/7, no row changed, no census line, as predicted; the fluent-bit-system route likewise (see the report). Pinned routes not runnable on the host.

Probe at 287dce8ed: three rule 43 caller shapes read the schedule (Unsafe/Unknown by order); tip: one verdict per shape. Census: suite 174 marked exit lines at base and tip, the 9 leafless non-fixture lines non-claimable (a published ESCAPED object); Fluent Bit opt-in and system routes no census line, no row changed. An exempt or non-live marked identity is no leak question and stays with rule 74c.

ledger.title: Rule 43's forget_published reads an intersection-joined published set but leaves a union-joined mark, so settled states can depend on the schedule
ledger.text: SETTLED-LEAK-MARK-LEAFLESS's JOINED fixture: x published on one arm, drain(q) after the join. The published set joins by intersection, the unresolved mark by union, and the first-arrival seed of a node's incoming state is the first edge alone. When the publishing arm reaches the join first, an iterate's drain marks x; the later join removes x from the published set but never the mark, so the settled exit carries a stale mark (no settled step produces it) and rule 11c's EXIT_WITHHELD fires; in the other order there is no mark. Rule 84 (amended) now publishes the witnessed open arm in both programs, so the verdict no longer depends on it, but the settled states and the leaf set still do (EXIT_WITHHELD present in one order only). DISCHARGE: make the forget monotone over the fixed point (e.g. mark every site published on some arriving path, or recompute marks from the settled published set), with fixtures in both orders and a census of moved rows.
